title: DNS service domain candidates
description: Staging file of domains seen in upstream DNS lists but not yet cataloged in dnsservices.json. Generated by scripts/fetch_dns_candidates.py.

added_on.description: First day the domain was seen in any source

last_checked.description: Last day its DNS was verified

resolves.description: Whether the domain currently has NS or SOA records

hint.description: Likely provider key (source metadata or NS fingerprint match)

sources.description: Upstream lists currently reporting the domain

status.description: Manual triage state, preserved across regenerations

validated.description: Manual flag: a reviewer verified the domain/hint

remark.description: Manual review note, e.g. why a domain was rejected
